name: Split-Tone Color Gel Portrait
description: Two contrasting colored gel lights split the same identity-locked model's face and body into saturated color halves, meeting at a hard, clean line that never softens into a blend. Bold and graphic, the same technical zip jacket carrying through one coherent campaign across every frame.
subject: person
prompt: standing straight-on and centered against a seamless neutral-grey studio ground, chest-up crop, wearing a matte black technical zip jacket with reflective trim tape down the zip line, lit by two contrasting colored gel lights, a saturated magenta gel on one side and an electric cyan gel on the other, splitting the face and jacket into two distinct color halves down the exact center of the frame, a hard clean line where the colors meet with no blended gradient and no third color, correct gel color temperature and real light falloff at the boundary rather than a digital overlay effect, shallow depth of field keeping both gel colors sharp on the subject while the grey background falls softly out of focus, bold modern graphic campaign finish
